description: This source file defines the ApplicationInfo class, which represents a launchable application in an Android environment, including its name, intent, icon, and associated methods.

classes.name: ApplicationInfo
classes.description: Represents a launchable application with properties for title, intent, icon, and a filtered flag, along with methods to manage its intent.

methods.name: setActivity
methods.description: Creates the application intent based on a component name and launch flags.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare ApplicationInfo objects based on title and intent component class name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() to generate a hash based on title and intent's component class name.
